@@ -0,0 +1,111 @@
+---
+- name: create upgrade test directory
+  file:
+    path: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade'
+    state: directory
+
+- name: install an older collection for upgrade
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install namespace1.name1:1.0.0 -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade'
+
+- name: upgrade to the latest stable release
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install -U namespace1.name1 -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade'
+  register: upgraded_collection
+
+- name: check stable upgrade result
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - "'Installing ''namespace1.name1:1.0.9''' in upgraded_collection.stdout"
+
+- name: repeat upgrade at the latest stable release
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install --upgrade namespace1.name1 -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade'
+  register: repeated_upgrade
+
+- name: check repeat upgrade is idempotent
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - "'Installing ''namespace1.name1:' not in repeated_upgrade.stdout"
+
+- name: allow prereleases during upgrade
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install -U --pre namespace1.name1 -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade'
+  register: prerelease_upgrade
+
+- name: check prerelease upgrade result
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - "'Installing ''namespace1.name1:1.1.0-beta.1''' in prerelease_upgrade.stdout"
+
+- name: enforce an upper version bound during upgrade
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install -U 'namespace1.name1:<1.0.9' -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade'
+  register: bounded_upgrade
+
+- name: check bounded upgrade result
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - "'Installing ''namespace1.name1:1.0.0''' in bounded_upgrade.stdout"
+
+- name: create upgrade requirements file
+  copy:
+    dest: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade-requirements.yml'
+    content: |
+      collections:
+        - name: namespace1.name1
+          version: '>=1.0.0,<1.1.0'
+        - name: namespace2.name
+
+- name: upgrade collections from requirements file
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install -U -r '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade-requirements.yml' -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade'
+  register: requirements_upgrade
+
+- name: check requirements file upgrade
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - "'Installing ''namespace1.name1:1.0.9''' in requirements_upgrade.stdout"
+    - "'Installing ''namespace2.name:' in requirements_upgrade.stdout"
+
+- name: install an incompatible dependency for upgrade
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install child_dep.child_collection:0.4.0 -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade'
+
+- name: upgrade collection with dependency requirement
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install -U parent_dep.parent_collection -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade'
+  register: dependency_upgrade
+
+- name: check incompatible dependency was upgraded
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - "'Installing ''child_dep.child_collection:0.9.9''' in dependency_upgrade.stdout"
+
+- name: repeat dependency upgrade
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install -U parent_dep.parent_collection -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade'
+  register: repeated_dependency_upgrade
+
+- name: check compatible dependency was preserved
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - "'Installing ''child_dep.child_collection:' not in repeated_dependency_upgrade.stdout"
+
+- name: install an old dependency again
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install --force child_dep.child_collection:0.4.0 -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade'
+
+- name: upgrade without dependencies
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install -U --no-deps parent_dep.parent_collection -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade'
+
+- name: read dependency left in place by no-deps
+  slurp:
+    path: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade/ansible_collections/child_dep/child_collection/MANIFEST.json'
+  register: no_deps_manifest
+
+- name: check no-deps did not change the dependency
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - (no_deps_manifest.content | b64decode | from_json).collection_info.version == '0.4.0'
+
+- name: reject an impossible upgrade constraint
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install -U 'namespace1.name1:<0.0.1' -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade'
+  register: impossible_upgrade
+  failed_when: false
+
+- name: check impossible upgrade failed clearly
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - impossible_upgrade.rc != 0
+    - "'Could not satisfy' in impossible_upgrade.stderr"

+    (False, False, '>=1.1.0', '1.2.0'),
+])
+def test_resolve_installed_upgrade(galaxy_server, monkeypatch, tmp_path_factory,
+                                   upgrade, pre, requirement, expected):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(galaxy_server, 'get_collection_versions', MagicMock(
+        return_value=['1.0.0', '1.1.0', '1.2.0', '1.3.0-beta.1']))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(galaxy_server, 'get_collection_version_metadata', MagicMock(

+    manager = collection.concrete_artifact_manager.ConcreteArtifactsManager(
+        to_text(tmp_path_factory.mktemp('upgrade')), validate_certs=False)
+    requirement_obj = Requirement('namespace.collection', requirement, None, 'galaxy')
+    installed = {Candidate('namespace.collection', '1.0.0', None, 'galaxy')}
+    resolved = collection._resolve_depenency_map(
+        [requirement_obj], [galaxy_server], manager, installed, False, pre,
+        upgrade=upgrade)
+    assert resolved['namespace.collection'].ver == expected
